dates.title: Johns Hopkins Admissions - Application Deadlines & Requirements

test.title: Johns Hopkins Admissions - Standardized Testing (score codes, English proficiency)

test_policy.notes: First-year applicants must submit SAT or ACT scores (self-report allowed; official scores required on enrollment). The CDS shows Peabody Conservatory considers but does not require scores.

requirements.notes: Two teacher evaluations from different academic subjects plus the secondary school report. 350-word Hopkins supplemental essay. CSS Profile is required for all international students applying for financial aid.

english_policy.waiver_notes: TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or Cambridge English are recommended but not required if your primary language is not English or you have not attended an English-language school for the last three years. JHU suggests submitting scores if SAT ERW is below 690 or ACT Reading and English are both below 30.

english.notes: To be competitive: total of 5 with preferred subscores (1-6 scale).
To be competitive: 7.0 or higher on each band.
To be competitive: composite 120 or higher with preferred subscores.

aid.notes: Need-based and merit scholarships are available to international applicants, but both are limited. You must apply for aid as a first-year applicant (no aid later); no aid for international transfer students. The page does not state whether admission is need-aware or whether full need is met for international students.

tier_notes.business: No undergraduate business major (business minor only).
tier_notes.nursing: No first-year BSN; Hopkins nursing entry is at the master's level.
tier_notes.engineering: Whiting School is a top-15 engineering school (biomedical engineering is #1).
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Biomedical sciences are top-5 nationally; largest NIH-funded research enterprise.
tier_notes.pre_med: Johns Hopkins medicine gives top-5 research access and pre-med reputation.
tier_notes.arts_design: Peabody Institute is a leading music conservatory.
